text: v1.0.16 is released: https://github.com/tjshea90/novig/releases/tag/v1.0.16 . Kalshi cards now have 'Bet on Kalshi' (own slip, no Novig read), the Kalshi slip shows the other books' odds table, and Kalshi cards are violet-tinted, Novig green. Your 3 new questions (CH38: why no Kalshi bids, Kalshi stats on the Engine tab, whether Bids-tab settings mirror to the engine) are next.
